trial_court: Principal Senior Civil Judge, CJM, Mandya, M.C.No.52/2012
case_name: B. Manjunath vs Smt. Jayasudha @ Sudha
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed petition under Section 13(1)(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, which was dismissed by trial court. Appeal against this judgment.

legal_principles.principle: A petition under Section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, is maintainable only if the petitioner has not been heard by the respondent.
legal_principles.held: It is held that a petition under Section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, is maintainable only if the petitioner has not been heard by the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that he has not been heard by the respondent.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that he has not been heard by the respondent.

outcome.final_order: Nothing survives for adjudication in this appeal. The appeal is disposed of.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
